propositions: Author an inert Pass-1 overlay prompt document for concurrency race detection that follows the established pattern of security and performance overlays, containing frontmatter with outputs, execution_mode, category, dimension, and langfuse_prompt keys.

The rubric must enforce a four-element lockset-first quartet: name the concurrency model (threads/async/multiprocessing source), flag unlocked-twin accessors that bypass sibling serialization discipline, cite all four race elements (shared mutable resource, concurrent executors, interleaving window with quoted reads/writes, concrete harm), and apply disposition-aware guard suppression with defer-by-name routing to security and performance overlays.
The prompt must instruct findings to use criteria: ["concurrency"], forbid model-emitted severity, and communicate that empty findings are expected for passing code.

The file must be structurally valid YAML with required frontmatter keys and all rubric sections (concurrency-model gate, lockset/sibling check, quartet elements, FP guards, evidence-record contract) present and locatable by grep.
